final: WITH c AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS t FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), s AS (SELECT CustomerId, t, t*1.0/(SELECT SUM(t) FROM c) AS sh FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(sh) AS av FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.t) AS avg_total, AVG(s.sh) AS avg_share, AVG(s.sh - a.av) AS avg_diff FROM s, a WHERE s.sh > a.av
